result.name: Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Information via HTTP
result.description: The remote host transmits sensitive authentication data (username and password) over an unencrypted HTTP connection on port 3000. An attacker with network access could intercept these credentials using a passive MITM attack.
result.solution: Enforce HTTPS on all endpoints. Implement HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) with a minimum max-age of 31536000 seconds. Redirect all HTTP traffic to HTTPS at the server or load-balancer level.

result.name: Missing HTTP Security Headers (CSP, X-Frame-Options, HSTS)
result.description: The web application does not set a Content-Security-Policy header, X-Frame-Options header, or Strict-Transport-Security header. This leaves the application vulnerable to cross-site scripting (XSS), clickjacking, and downgrade attacks.
result.solution: Add the following response headers: Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options: DENY, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains.

result.name: SQL Injection via Login Endpoint (authentication bypass)
result.description: The /rest/user/login endpoint is vulnerable to SQL injection. Supplying the payload "' OR 1=1--" in the email field bypasses authentication and grants admin access. The underlying SQLite query concatenates user input directly without parameterization.
result.solution: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements. Never concatenate user-supplied input into SQL strings. Apply input validation as a defense-in-depth measure. Consider a WAF rule to block common SQLi payloads at the perimeter.

result.name: Weak Password Policy — Accepts Single-Character Passwords
result.description: The /api/Users endpoint accepts account registration with a password of a single character. No minimum length, complexity, or common-password check is enforced. This allows trivially guessable credentials to be set.
result.solution: Enforce a minimum password length of 12 characters. Require at least one uppercase letter, number, and special character. Check against a list of commonly used passwords (e.g. HaveIBeenPwned API). Implement account lockout after 5 failed attempts.

result.name: Directory Listing Enabled on /ftp Endpoint
result.description: The /ftp path exposes a directory listing of sensitive files including legal.md, coupons_2013.md.bak, and acquisitions.md. Attackers can download confidential documents without authentication.
result.solution: Disable directory listing in the web server configuration. Move sensitive files outside the web root. Apply authentication to any file download endpoints.

result.name: Session Cookie Missing Secure and HttpOnly Flags
result.description: The JWT token stored in the browser localStorage and the session cookie do not have the Secure or HttpOnly flags set. This exposes them to theft via XSS or network sniffing.
result.solution: Set Secure and HttpOnly flags on all session cookies. Migrate from localStorage to HttpOnly cookies for JWT token storage.
